Pokhara is a city on a lake.
# Pokhara

## Get in

By bus or by plane.

### Visas

A visa on arrival; afterwards buses get around the lake.

## Get around

Taxis, buses and boats.

## Get into trouble

Not advised.

## Sightseeing

You can see the peaks from the lake.

## See

The World Peace Pagoda 😀.

## First steps

### Aid stations

There is one at the trail head.

## Treatment > First Aid

Rest and fluids.

## Stay safe

### Scams

Agree the fare first.

## Stay safely indoors

In the monsoon.

## Go next

A trip to Bandipur.
